description: Resize every page of a PDF to A4, Letter, Legal, A3, A5 or a custom size — content is scaled proportionally, nothing is cropped.

faqs.a: No — pages are scaled to fit the target size while keeping their aspect ratio (letterboxed). Use the Fill option if you prefer edge-to-edge scaling with cropping.
Vector text and graphics scale perfectly at any size. Scanned/image pages are resampled by your PDF viewer when printed.
No. Everything is processed in your browser; the PDF never leaves your device.

howto: Pick a target page size (A4, Letter, Legal, A3, A5 or custom).
Click Resize pages, then download the new PDF.
title: PDF Page Size Changer
